Name: Warzone
Details:
Your objective is to drop into an active warzone and survive a gauntlet of enemy forces. You must withstand up to 10 waves of hostile reinforcements. You can choose to extract after the third wave by moving a 'Mech to the extraction zone and ending their turn there. Push as far as you dare.

Expected Forces: <color=#F04228>12–40 'Mechs</color>
